label: HINDSIGHT: every rule was registered 2026-09-26, after every month here; this receipt asks whether a lead survives a change of rebalance CALENDAR, nothing more
why: ROADMAP_2026-09-28 lane M1; adversarial review 2026-09-28 §1 and §5.2: only mom_12_1_q had been run at its three quarterly offsets
verdict_rule: v2 (changed 2026-09-28 AFTER the first verdicts were seen; review F3/F4/F9): an offset BEATS its matched twin when the full-window mean monthly rule - twin > 0 AND t >= 2 on its rebalance blocks. ROBUST_TO_CALENDAR = all three beat; CALENDAR_ARTEFACT = the best offset (highest t) beats and at least one other has t < 1; CANNOT_DISTINGUISH = otherwise; NOT_COMPUTED = an offset with no t or < 3 blocks. Read on 2 disjoint seed sets of 21 twin draws; sets that disagree -> CANNOT_DISTINGUISH. Why changed: v1's LOSES needed mean <= 0, which a 12-1-tercile-matched twin almost never gives a momentum sort, so v1 could almost never say ARTEFACT.
verdict_rule_v1: an offset BEATS its matched twin when the full-window mean monthly rule - twin21 > 0 AND t >= 2 on the rule's own rebalance blocks; LOSES when that mean <= 0. ROBUST_TO_CALENDAR = all three offsets beat; CALENDAR_ARTEFACT = >= 1 beats and >= 1 other loses; CANNOT_DISTINGUISH = anything else. Declared in backend/services/calendar_offsets.py before the 2026-09-28 run.

rule_changed_after_first_verdicts.why: review F3 (docs/reviews/REVIEW_2026-09-28_LANE_M_MEASUREMENT.md): v1's LOSES needed mean <= 0, which a 12-1-tercile-matched twin almost never gives a momentum sort, so v1 could almost never label a calendar artefact; v2 is the roadmap's LANE M1 rule (committed in b1010061 before either run). F4: one seed set decided labels at t 2.04-2.12, so v2 reads two disjoint 21-draw seed sets and stores every draw's t. F9: a missing t is NOT_COMPUTED, not a measured null. This receipt is a NEW run id; the two earlier receipts are kept unchanged.

conventions.engine: strategy_library.run_strategy with rebalance_months; band costs on (cost_scale 1.0)
conventions.twin: matched_twins: size band x vol_63 tercile x 12-1 tercile, 21 seeded draws (seed_for(cell id)); twin net = twin gross - the rule's cost that month
conventions.t_blocks: non-overlapping rebalance periods (block value = sum of monthly differences)
conventions.by_year: keyed on the HOLD month (entry session = decision date + 1 business day)
conventions.dsr_rule_minus_twin21_n_trials: 288 (the reference board's candidate rules, as the leads doc read rule - twin21)

bar_screen.note: ON = the reader default; OFF = audit leg, pre-screen panel, book refusal not enforced

iwm.alignment: daily total return compounded over (month-end, next month-end]
